note: Asset source catalogue for the asset-research stage (D-022). scripts/assets/explore.mjs searches every source whose kinds match, in this order. access: api-auto = search + download scripted; url-auto = search scraped, direct file URL works with the 'url' source type; explore-only = search works, download is manual (user) or not scripted; auth = needs a user account token in the environment. Verified from this container on 2026-09-26.
auth_policy: Never ask for a token or password in chat. When explore.mjs finds candidates on an auth source (or cannot search it without a key), it writes assets/auth-requests.json; the agent then asks the user to create an account and add the named environment variable in the cloud environment settings (Edit → environment variables). A new session picks it up.

sources.name: Openverse (Flickr, Wikimedia …)
sources.licence: per item (search limited to cc0, pdm, by, by-sa, by-nc, by-nc-sa)

sources.name: Kenney
sources.search: https://kenney.nl/assets?search= (page scrape); pack zip link on each asset page

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.download_note: Pack downloads are a Google Drive folder or itch.io — the user downloads and uploads, or the agent uses a direct file link if one is given.

sources.name: Three D Scans
sources.licence: no copyright restrictions (site statement) — record as public-domain after checking the item page

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.licence: per item (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / GPL mixed)
sources.download_note: Check the licence line on every item page; GPL-only items are not allowed.

sources.name: Mixkit
sources.licence: Mixkit License (free; check the item's licence type)

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.licence: per item (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / CC-BY-NC …; 'Standard' and 'Editorial' are not allowed)
sources.auth_note: Search is public; download (/v3/models/{uid}/download) returns 401 without a token. Token: sketchfab.com → Settings → Password & API.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.auth_note: Search itself needs the key (API 401, site 403 from this container). Key: pexels.com/api after login.

sources.name: Unsplash
sources.auth_note: Not requested by the user yet; listed for completeness, not searched.
